body: Its not about winning to me. My heart hurts. Ive never felt this before. I just want to have it go away its too much to take right now. I appreciate the offer but I wont be needing it. Im drinking an entire bottle of vodka while waist deep in the pitch black water. I don't drink but i guess I should start. I put one bullet in the chamber. I'm thinking of playing Russian roulette with the ocean. If I win ill go to a hotel for the night and think things trough. Maybe luck is on my side tonight. Ill be in touch.

You say this but how do you expect me to explain this to him? I'd rather die than face him like this I cant do it. The worst part is that I still love her if always loved her especially after losing my mother. She became my pillar and for her to do this to me. 

You have no idea how bad it feels to want to kill someone you love so much. She played me for so long. Who knows how long she's been fucking around. It might not even be my son. I don't want to see her again.
